dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature, transitioning from a broad base to the apex with a shallow inward arc.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded, with a curvature radius approximately 1/8th of the vertical height of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge rises at an angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum pixel base width to the maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 1.6:1.
